killedBy: the screen capture adapter refuses a recipe this producer cannot honour, rather than capturing something else
why: Accepts a recipe asking for full motion while the runner emulates reduced motion regardless -- so the recipe would DOCUMENT one thing and the capture do another, which is worse than either alone. It is also the flake this whole producer is built to avoid: a crossfade caught mid-flight on a slow machine and settled on a fast one is a screenshot that does not reproduce.
